name: Introduction to Quantum Photonics
description: Basics of quantum mechanics; cavity quantum electrodynamics: quantization of electromagnetic field, spontaneous emission, Purcell effect, Jaynes-Cummings and Tavis-Cummings models; cooperative phenomena and applications: superradiance, subradiance, and applications in quantum memories; nonclassical states of light: coherent, Schrodinger’s cat and squeezed states, EPR paradox, and photonic entanglement; quantum systems and photonic applications: self-assembled quantum dots, optomechanical systems and NV center in diamond, quantum dot-based single and entangled photon generation, applications of nonclassical light in quantum communication and quantum sensing.
